basic_profile.bio: A 25-year-old computer science graduate living in Seattle, juggling between a budding career in software development and my passion for collecting vinyl records. I spend my free time exploring new and old music, with a particular love for Biffy Clyro and Japanese rock bands. Not a fan of overly corporate environments, I'm currently single and enjoy the flexibility to explore new opportunities. Most active on Reddit during evenings, usually after 7 PM PST, when I wind down from coding.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science, I honed my skills through university projects and internships. I'm particularly interested in algorithms and problem-solving, often participating in coding challenges and hackathons. My knowledge is further enriched by self-learning and staying updated with industry trends through online courses and tech blogs.
